summary: Retest of the iteration 71 fixes for Formular, Dokument hochladen and Konto eröffnen. Backend: new pytest file with 27 tests, all passing. Frontend: Playwright E2E on desktop and mobile. All fixes I tested work. (1) Short code 'AB' on /formular and /dokument-upload shows a German toast, with no crash and no page errors. (2) All 12 /api/send-*-contract-email endpoints return 401 with the German 'Formular-Sitzung abgelaufen' message when the X-Formular-Session header is missing or invalid; with a valid session they return 200 and session_id is stored on the record. Full UI submits of ING Flexgeld and Knab Festgeld worked: the success card shows with scrollY=0. (3) The contract PDF and signature are persisted: files[] has file_id and storage_path, contract_pdf_path and attachments are set. In the admin 'Vertrags-Einreichungen' dialog both 'Öffnen' buttons load the download proxy (200 application/pdf, real %PDF bytes, PNG for the signature). Anonymous download returns 401/403. (4) customer_name 'inj' is escaped in the admin and customer HTML. The summary is built from the formSummary dict and escaped; raw formSummaryHtml is stripped to text. (5) The public response contains only success, submissionId, savedToDashboard, adminEmailSent and customerEmailSent. (6) _send_with_retry makes 3 attempts on 429 and 1 attempt on other errors (unit-tested). (7) The wrong-code lockout is now per client IP (first XFF hop): one IP gets 429 after 10 fails while other IPs and the real client still get 401. (8) The register success screen says 'Ihr Zugang ist aktiv'. Regression checks passed: document upload (UI on mobile plus API, single use, admin download %PDF) and register plus onboarding PATCH (API) and register UI. New issues found: a regression in the Festgeld admin summary, raw JSON in the error toast, XFF spoofing, and copy contradictions.

minor.issue: REGRESSION: when formSummary is non-empty the server ignores formSummaryHtml. The Festgeld forms only send {iban, secondInvestor}, so the admin email and the admin summary lose Anlagebetrag, Zinssatz, Laufzeit, Willkommensbonus and Zinsgutschrift, which the old HTML summary contained. Verified: the Knab Festgeld record summary keys are only ['iban','secondInvestor']. Fix: send the same full formSummary dict as the Flexgeld forms, and map keys to German labels on the server (keys like 'investmentAmount' are currently shown raw).

The first X-Forwarded-For hop is controlled by the client. The ingress appends to the header, so an attacker can send any X-Forwarded-For value and get a fresh bucket on every request. This bypasses the 10-fail code brute-force lock and the per-minute submit/register limits. Verified: random spoofed XFF values each got their own counter. Recommend taking the hop just before the trusted ingress (e.g. xff.split(',')[-2] when there are 2 or more hops; the real client IP 34.7.x appeared as the first entry when no XFF was sent). The email-keyed login lockout is not affected.
These still use the LAST XFF hop (split(',')[-1]), which is the ingress IP, even though the comment says 'VORDERSTE'. Any slowapi limiter and the reviews limit are therefore still global.

The customer name is used in the attachment filename without sanitizing, e.g. 'ING_Flexgeldvertrag_inj.pdf'. Restrict it to [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Also, _store_file is annotated as returning Optional[str] but returns a tuple.

ui_bugs.issue: On a 401 or other FastAPI error the toast shows raw JSON: 'Fehler: {"detail":"Ihre Formular-Sitzung ist abgelaufen..."}'. apiErrorMessage only reads j.error, not j.detail. On 401 the form should also redirect to /formular.

design_issues.screen: Contract forms 'Online einreichen' box (Ing/BBVA/Bunq/BunqDe/Postbank Flex plus several Festgeld forms)
issues: The copy says 'Sie erhalten keine automatische E-Mail-Bestätigung', but the backend now sends a customer confirmation email with the PDF. The admin dialog also says 'Es wird nur eine Admin-Benachrichtigung ... gesendet'. Align the copy with the actual behaviour.

The success view is not scrolled to the top, so at 1920 the user only sees the 'Zur Startseite' button. It also uses the 'Registrierung eingegangen' eyebrow with a Clock icon, and the form subtitle still says 'Freischaltung in 1–2 Werktagen', which contradicts 'Ihr Zugang ist aktiv'. Consider adding an 'Anmelden' CTA.
The 'Aktien im Fokus' promo popup appears over the success screen in the formular flow.

action_items: Send the full formSummary dict (amount, rate, term, bonus, interestPayment, iban, secondInvestor) from all Festgeld forms, and render German labels in _summary_html.
apiErrorMessage: read j.detail (string) as well as j.error. On 401 from a contract endpoint, redirect to /formular.
Make rate-limit IP extraction trust only the ingress-appended hop (not the client-supplied first hop). Fix server.py _client_ip and the reviews limiter, which still use the last hop.
Sanitize the contract filename built from customer_name.
Align the 'keine automatische E-Mail-Bestätigung' copy and the admin dialog text with the customer confirmation email that is now sent.
Register: scrollTo(0,0) on success, and remove the 'Freischaltung in 1–2 Werktagen' subtitle.
critical_code_review_comments: contract_pdf_path stores a file_id, not a path. This works with the download proxy but the name is misleading.
The session gate allows unlimited submissions per session (limited only by the 5/min per-IP limit, which can be bypassed via XFF). Consider a per-session cap.
There is still no DELETE endpoint for contract submissions; cleanup has to be done through Mongo.
AdminContractSubmissions and DokumentHochladen still lack data-testids.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all retested fixes pass; 1 error-toast UX bug)

seed_data_creation: Temporary formular code (Y8JRZP6M) and doc code (LWYHBS2U), 3 contract submissions, 2 doc uploads and 2 registered audit+reg72 users were created. All were deleted afterwards (storage_files soft-deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-n 0'. The test sends a random X-Forwarded-For header per request to avoid shared rate limits. Contract endpoints need the 'X-Formular-Session' header (get it via POST /api/formular-access/verify). The form filler helper is /tmp/fill_form.py; in browser_automation load it with exec(open(...).read(), globals()). The customer name field strips digits. Contract submissions can only be cleaned via Mongo (contract_form_submissions plus storage_files subject_id). @example.com customer mails return 422 from the provider (expected).
rca of the issue: Festgeld summary loss: the server's _summary_html prefers the dict over the HTML, and the Festgeld forms were only partly migrated (dict has 2 keys, HTML had 8 rows). Raw JSON toast: apiErrorMessage falls back to the raw text when there is no 'error' key, and FastAPI returns 'detail'.
